_meta.purpose: Authoritative feature discovery index for node repo dev/cron work. Check here before claiming a feature exists.

autoMatchRequires: at least one evidence overlap in files or githubIssues

arken/node/feature#1.canonicalName: recursive entity and query schema contracts
arken/node/feature#1.description: Defines shared zod contracts for ObjectId-bearing entities, common status fields, recursive Prisma-style where clauses, and standardized status/data query envelopes.
verificationSignals: ObjectId schema accepts valid 24-character ObjectId strings and Mongoose Types.ObjectId instances
createPrismaWhereSchema converts raw field shorthand into equals-style operator objects
recursive AND/OR/NOT where clauses are generated up to the configured depth
getQueryInput only enables where support for object schemas and partials object data by default
getQueryOutput emits a shared { status, data, error } result envelope

arken/node/feature#2.canonicalName: mongo filter translation and validated HTTP fetch helper
arken/node/feature#2.description: Translates Prisma-like where input into Mongo filter fragments and wraps outbound POST fetches with URL/query validation, normalized URL trimming, and deterministic timeouts.
verificationSignals: id and _id conditions normalize to _id across equals, contains, and in operators
scalar shorthand values work at both root and nested logical nodes
empty contains, empty in, and equals=undefined fragments are dropped as no-op filters
nested AND/OR composition is preserved in the generated Mongo filter
fetch rejects blank, malformed, and non-http(s) URLs before network dispatch
fetch rejects non-object query payloads and applies a deterministic 10000ms axios timeout

arken/node/feature#3.canonicalName: typed RPC serialization and compatibility util surface
arken/node/feature#3.description: Provides cross-runtime serialize/deserialize helpers for ObjectId-like values and other special JS types, safe binary payload decoding, and explicit util subpath bridges that avoid circular package-root re-exports.
verificationSignals: serialize tags ObjectId, BigInt, Date, RegExp, ArrayBuffer, Uint8Array, Set, and Map values with _type metadata
deserialize rehydrates supported special values and decodes byteLength-backed payloads into JSON
decodePayload returns undefined on malformed binary strings and logs only a truncated payload preview
@arken/node/util exposes getFilter, serialize, and deserialize through dedicated bridge files instead of a circular root re-export

arken/node/feature#4.canonicalName: socket tRPC client link, proxy, and server-push handling
arken/node/feature#4.description: Routes tRPC operations to named Socket.IO backends, allocates collision-resistant request IDs, registers callbacks before emit for same-tick responses, enforces request timeouts, and supports server-push handling with malformed-payload resilience.
verificationSignals: unknown router prefixes and missing backend clients fail fast with TRPCClientError
backend-only paths without a method segment are rejected before any socket emit
request IDs are allocated with collision checks against active ioCallbacks
request timeout errors include reqId metadata and clean up callback state
attachTrpcResponseHandler can prefer onAny, ignores malformed payloads, and only resolves own-property callback IDs
server-push payloads tolerate deserialize failures without crashing the handler

arken/node/feature#5.description: Executes socket-delivered tRPC calls against nested router methods, normalizes request IDs and method strings, emits deterministic status envelopes, and blocks prototype or inherited-path traversal.
verificationSignals: malformed payloads emit a status-0 trpcResponse with a deterministic malformed-payload error
non-string or blank methods emit an explicit missing-or-invalid method error
whitespace-trimmed valid methods dispatch successfully
__proto__, prototype, constructor, empty-segment, and inherited built-in prototype method paths are rejected as missing handlers
response IDs are trimmed when valid and dropped when blank, non-string, or reserved
attachSocketTrpcListener safely no-ops when the socket does not expose on/off hooks

arken/node/feature#6.description: Implements a fetch-based JSON-RPC provider with constructor URL validation, caller-request immutability, runtime cache guards, timeout plus abort behavior, bounded 403 failover, and deterministic RequestError normalization.
verificationSignals: constructor trims URLs and rejects malformed or non-http(s) endpoints with -32602 Invalid provider URL errors
request rejects non-object payloads and missing or blank methods with -32600 invalid-request errors
request-default injection preserves caller-owned request objects instead of mutating them
hung fetches are aborted when AbortController is available and normalize back to timeout-shaped RequestError metadata
malformed cache hits, malformed response envelopes, response text read failures, and fetch rejections normalize into deterministic provider errors
403 responses fail closed when no alternate provider exists instead of recursing indefinitely

arken/node/feature#7.canonicalName: database bootstrap and normalized model wrapper
arken/node/feature#7.description: Provides Mongo bootstrap helpers, in-memory collection scaffolding, schema/model factories, _id-to-id JSON normalization, asJSON query helpers, and application-scoped direct-id caching for model reads and updates.
verificationSignals: initMongoose connects using MONGO_ENDPOINT and closes the connection on SIGINT
addIdTransformHelpers applies toJSON, toObject, and query.asJSON normalization that converts root and nested ObjectIds into string ids
applyJsonToDoc rehydrates string ids back into ObjectIds for schema-defined fields
direct _id findOne and find queries can use the TTL cache when populate, lean, projection, sort, skip, and limit modifiers are absent
updateOne, findOneAndUpdate, and bulkWrite paths update or clear cached documents when a direct id is known

arken/node/feature#8.canonicalName: ontology cluster resolution for model lookups
arken/node/feature#8.description: Maintains per-entity Cluster records keyed by kind, application, primary key, aliases, and weighted tags so query wrappers can resolve documents by pk fields or tag similarity instead of only raw _id filters.
verificationSignals: upsertClusterForEntity merges keys, weighted tags, pk entries, and currentRevision/currentId into the Cluster record
resolveClustersForFilter builds pk elemMatch conditions and weighted tag scores, then sorts by score or updatedDate
low-confidence tag matches warn and fall back to raw queries instead of forcing an uncertain cluster choice
close-score tag matches emit ambiguity warnings with candidate cluster ids
raw-query fallbacks backfill Cluster records for future lookups

arken/node/feature#9.canonicalName: pluggable zk proof gate for model writes
arken/node/feature#9.description: Lets callers register a global zk verifier and route create/update model operations through createWithProof and updateOneWithProof, passing write context into the verifier before persistence.
verificationSignals: setZkVerifier installs a process-wide verifier callback
createWithProof forwards kind, operation=create, and the pending document payload into the verifier context
updateOneWithProof forwards kind, operation=update, filter, and update into the verifier context
when no verifier is registered, proof-gated helpers fall back to normal write behavior instead of hard failing

arken/node/feature#10.description: Generates and verifies Groth16 proofs for the UpdateLeaf(16) circuit, normalizes field inputs, resolves proving assets across repo/build/runtime paths, and ships a regeneration script plus committed circuit artifacts.
verificationSignals: generateProof rejects sibling arrays deeper than the configured tree depth and pads shorter paths to depth 16
hex and decimal leaf/root values are normalized into decimal field strings before snarkjs fullProve
asset resolution checks repo-local and process.cwd-relative data/zk paths before failing
verifyProof loads verification_key.json and validates Groth16 public signals
zk-regen-updateLeaf rebuilds the circom, wasm, zkey, and verification-key outputs for data/zk/circuits/updateLeaf.circom

arken/node/feature#11.canonicalName: sparse round-state transition proof chains and branch witnesses
arken/node/feature#11.description: Builds deterministic Poseidon/keccak sparse-tree proofs for entity state transitions, including single-step proofs, multi-entity chained root transitions, branch witness generation, import-witness verification, and anchored-branch continuation rules.
verificationSignals: proveSingleEntityRoundTransition returns null when before and after state payloads serialize identically
proveRoundStateTransitions chains newRoot to oldRoot across multiple proofs and returns baseStateRoot, postStateRoot, and nextBranch metadata
untracked anchored-branch inserts require either an empty pre-state or an explicit branch witness
createRoundStateImportWitness plus verifyRoundStateImportWitness prove that an imported entity leaf matches the claimed branch root
generated proofs in test/roundStateProof.spec.ts verify successfully through verifyProof(...)
notes: This feature is present in the current worktree and is not re-exported from index.ts yet.

arken/node/feature#12.canonicalName: time helpers and serial task queue
arken/node/feature#12.description: Provides shared UTC/local time utilities, debouncing, duration formatting, timestamp conversion, and a serial async task queue that preserves enqueue order, survives task failures, and restarts on tail-handoff races.
verificationSignals: queued tasks execute in FIFO order
the queue continues processing after a task throws
a task enqueued during the tail handoff window is still processed without being stranded
the exported surface includes sleep, timestamp, convert, removeTimezoneOffset, debounce, and timestampToTime

arken/node/feature#13.canonicalName: web3 signing, contract, and block-iteration helpers
arken/node/feature#13.description: Exposes request-signing and verification helpers, provider selection, block-range iteration, address and contract utilities, AES encrypt/decrypt helpers, and bytes32 conversion functions for higher-level web3 flows.
verificationSignals: isValidRequest recovers the signer and compares it to the claimed address
getSignedRequest returns address, hash, and data using web3 eth accounts sign
iterateBlocks paginates log scans in 5000-block windows and can persist progress through updateConfig
getContract rejects zero or invalid addresses before constructing an ethers Contract
toBytes32 rejects strings longer than 32 bytes

arken/node/feature#14.canonicalName: legacy Arken data, contract, and item decode compatibility
arken/node/feature#14.description: Preserves historical Arken contract metadata, farm and gameplay catalogs, and token decoding helpers so newer services can still read legacy runtime identifiers and content bundles.
verificationSignals: legacy/README.md documents the folder as the backward-compatibility bridge for historical runtime behavior
decoder.ts reads generated item catalogs and exposes token-cache helpers plus decodeItem and normalizeItem paths
legacy/contracts stores archived contract artifacts for compatibility lookups
legacy/data/generated bundles historical gameplay and economy catalogs
notes: decoder.test.ts currently has only placeholder active coverage, so decoder behavior is supported by code and legacy data assets more than by focused tests.

arken/node/feature#15.canonicalName: puppeteer browser bootstrap and page orchestration helpers
arken/node/feature#15.description: Provides a shared Puppeteer helper surface for headless browser launch, page bootstrap, bounded navigation settling, auto-scroll, and target-tab discovery; this surface is actively consumed by multiple cerebro-hub agents.
verificationSignals: open launches Puppeteer headless with no-sandbox, dev-shm, web-security, notifications, and zygote guards
newPage sets deterministic headers and viewport, supports optional evaluateOnNewDocument injection, and can force window.stop() after a bounded settle delay
findPage initializes matching tabs once with a desktop user agent, request interception, and asset blocking for stylesheet, font, and image requests
browser.ts is imported by live cerebro-hub agents including Enel, Erina, Kirito, Tai, and Yumeko
notes: This feature is code-backed and actively consumed cross-repo, but it does not currently have focused unit coverage in arken/node.

arken/node/feature#16.description: Provides text-language detection, keyword extraction, summarization, entity recognition, message-complexity scoring, and an optional OpenAI-backed analysis fallback that returns tags, summary, and entities when enabled for higher-complexity inputs.
verificationSignals: isEnglish uses langdetect.detectOne and only returns true for the detected en language code
extractKeywords derives the top TF-IDF terms from the message via natural.WordTokenizer and natural.TfIdf
recognizeEntities merges unique people, place, and organization entities discovered by compromise
analyzeText only invokes analyzeTextWithGPT when enableApiFallback is true and the computed complexity score exceeds 7
analyzeTextWithGPT falls back to local keyword, summary, and entity analysis when the OpenAI request fails
the helper surface is consumed by cerebro-hub's Binzy agent for message-language and analysis flows
notes: This feature is code-backed and cross-repo-consumed, but it does not currently have focused unit coverage in arken/node.
